items.title: Jonathan Scales interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 23, 2025
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Maria Schneider said something that I just found was very illuminating... [INTERVIEWEE] Yes. I actually had this conversation with someone last night... I was trying to say the same thing to them.

ctx.x: that is right now I mean I feel a little bit inarticulate about that right now because it’s on the spot. But like yeah, I think that life is very influential. Like my music, a lot of my music, it comes from real life.

Maria Schneider said something that I just found was very illuminating. It was right near the end of our interview, and she just said, “Sometimes I tell my composition students, ‘Listen, you just have to live. You have to live. You have to go out and do different things, not just music things. Go out and live and experience other things or your music will suffer for not doing that.’”

Yes. I actually had this conversation with someone last night, you know about like practicing. Someone kind of like – I was trying to say the same thing to them. And they were like, “Yeah but how can you get to somewhere if you didn’t practice?” And I’m like yes, you’re right. But also there’s a thin fine line in the balance because you know I think they were talking about how you know practice a lot, or when I was younger how consistent I was.
